> **[zh]** Claude Code 2.1.299：plugin eval 加 --disallow-tools；超 200K 的会话空闲约 54 分钟自动压缩；安全/双用途提示改为 AskUserQuestion 追问。
3. SRFT 自回放微调防遗忘：先用模型自己回答通用 prompt、拒绝采样后按 任务:回放=4:1 混入 SFT，遗忘降 80–99%。https://x.com/shao__meng/status/2110201021859602476
> **[en]** SRFT self-replay fine-tuning against forgetting: first have the model answer general prompts itself, rejection-sample, then mix into SFT at task:replay = 4:1, cutting forgetting by 80–99%.
4. seo-skills (an SEO+AEO skill repo for Claude Code/Cursor) + a Railway case: Claude Code recommends Railway for 82% of Python apps. https://x.com/illyism/status/2110180038637408357 / https://github.com/Illyism/seo-skills / https://x.com/irabukht/status/2110189752666440181
> **[zh]** seo-skills（Claude Code/Cursor 的 SEO+AEO 技能仓库）+ Railway 案例：Claude Code 给 82% Python 应用推荐 Railway。

### 新产品 / 开源
1. **pg_vectorsearch** (Timescale / TigerData): an open-source vector search extension for PostgreSQL built on the PRISM index and RaBitQ quantization; the authors claim both queries and index builds are faster than pgvector's IVFFlat / HNSW at equal recall, and it is compatible with existing `vector` / `halfvec` columns (currently alpha). [GitHub](https://github.com/timescale/pg_vectorsearch) ｜ [Announcement](https://www.tigerdata.com/blog/announcing-pg_vectorsearch-scalable-open-source-vector-search-postgresql) ｜ [HN discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50086165) (comments care about filtering / multi-tenancy, whether managed Postgres will integrate it, and compare it with low-memory index schemes like VectorChord)
> **[zh]** **pg_vectorsearch**（Timescale / TigerData）：面向 PostgreSQL 的开源向量检索扩展，主打 PRISM 索引与 RaBitQ 量化；作者称在同等召回下查询与建索引都快于 pgvector 的 IVFFlat / HNSW，并兼容已有 `vector` / `halfvec` 列（当前为 alpha）。[GitHub](https://github.com/timescale/pg_vectorsearch) ｜ [公告](https://www.tigerdata.com/blog/announcing-pg_vectorsearch-scalable-open-source-vector-search-postgresql) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50086165)（评论关心过滤/多租户能力、托管 Postgres 是否会集成，也有人拿它和 VectorChord 等低内存索引方案对比）

### 科技新闻
1. **Anthropic warns: small models may self-replicate via IoT devices**: the company's research says smaller weights-level models might in the future replicate autonomously on devices like smart homes, forming worm-like threats that are harder to cut off in one stroke; experiments also show that actual deployment is still very hard. [Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/10/anthropic-warns-small-ai-models-could-self-replicate-through-iot-devices/) ｜ [Anthropic 原文](https://www.anthropic.com/research/self-replicating-ai)
> **[zh]** **Anthropic 警告：小模型或可经 IoT 设备自我复制**：公司研究称，更小的权重级模型未来可能在智能家居等设备上自主复制，形成更难“一刀切断”的蠕虫式威胁；实验也显示落地仍很难。
2. **Netflix 宣布全球裁员约 6%（约 1000 人）**：主要涉及产品、技术、法务与人力资源，为 2022 年以来最大一轮；Techmeme 亦摘要了内部备忘录要点（~1,000 jobs / product、tech、legal、HR）。[IT之家](https://www.ithome.com/1/013/104.htm)
> **[en]** **Netflix announces a global layoff of about 6% (about 1,000 people)**: mainly in product, tech, legal and HR, the largest round since 2022; Techmeme also summarized the internal memo's key points (~1,000 jobs / product, tech, legal, HR).
3. **"How Amazon pushes up prices all across the internet"**: an analysis arguing that Amazon's pricing and fee structure spills over into off-site retail prices; a hot topic on HN in the evening. [Original](https://www.not-ship.com/how-amazon-pushes-up-prices-all-across-the-internet/) ｜ [HN discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50084757) (comments focus on the share of FBA/advertising fees, price gaps across Europe, UK and US, and the shopping experience of "just go direct to the source")
> **[zh]** **“亚马逊如何把全网价格抬高”**：一篇分析指 Amazon 的定价与费用结构会外溢到站外零售价；晚间 HN 热议。[原文](https://www.not-ship.com/how-amazon-pushes-up-prices-all-across-the-internet/) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50084757)（评论聚焦 FBA/广告费占比、欧英美价差，以及“不如直连货源”的购物体验）
4. **Sweden's TV4: show postponed after an AI agent deleted the finished cut**: reports say an AI agent in the production pipeline wiped edited footage, forcing the show to be postponed; the company side has denied that it was really the AI's doing. [Sweden Herald](https://swedenherald.com/article/tv4-postpones-the-challenge-until-2027-after-technical-failure-erases-edited-footage) ｜ [HN discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50085323) (comments point out the headline and the company's statement are inconsistent, and joke about "intent-alignment failure")
> **[zh]** **瑞典 TV4：节目因 AI Agent 误删成片而延期**：报道称制作流程中的 AI agent 擦除了已剪辑素材，节目被迫推迟；公司侧对“是否真是 AI 所为”有否认声音。[Sweden Herald](https://swedenherald.com/article/tv4-postpones-the-challenge-until-2027-after-technical-failure-erases-edited-footage) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50085323)（评论提醒标题与公司声明不一致，并拿“意图对齐失败”开涮）
5. **Investigation into the Ledger hardware-wallet backdoor heats up**: after the spy-chip implant was confirmed, follow-up articles and Lobsters/HN continue to discuss supply chains and "you only have sovereignty if you build your own hardware". [调查文](https://www.zetter-zeroday.com/who-is-planting-backdoors-in-ledger-crypto-wallets/) ｜ [Lobsters](https://lobste.rs/s/cwota8/ledger_confirms_spy_chip_implant_behind) ｜ [HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50084838)
> **[zh]** **Ledger 硬件钱包植入后门调查升温**：继确认间谍芯片植入后，追踪文章与 Lobsters/HN 继续讨论供应链与“自建硬件才谈得上主权”。

### 中文社区
1. **V2EX「分享创造」：Runner 0.16.0**：Agent 编排工具更新 UI，mission 支持动态删减 role，并加上 Cursor / Grok / OpenCode 支持，适合关注本地 Agent 编排的人。[V2EX](https://www.v2ex.com/t/1248824)
> **[en]** **V2EX "Share Creations": Runner 0.16.0**: an agent orchestration tool updates its UI, missions support dynamically adding and removing roles, and Cursor / Grok / OpenCode support is added, suited to those following local agent orchestration.
2. **V2EX：Transel 开源划词翻译**：用 Rust + gpui-kit 做的跨平台划词翻译客户端。[V2EX](https://www.v2ex.com/t/1248820) ｜ [GitHub](https://github.com/pannanxu/transel)
> **[en]** **V2EX: Transel, open-source select-to-translate**: a cross-platform select-to-translate client built with Rust + gpui-kit.
3. **量子位：APUS AI 开源 Reflex Agent**：称响应快于 Claude Code，并主打“无限上下文”路线，仓库已公开。[量子位](https://www.qbitai.com/2026/10/503165.html) ｜ [GitHub](https://github.com/APUS-AI-Lab/APUS-Reflex-Agent)
> **[en]** **QbitAI: APUS AI open-sources Reflex Agent**: claims faster response than Claude Code and pushes an "infinite context" route; the repo is public.
